summary: gate.staleness-scope.10 / F3 (spec fidelity): brief F3 defines git_unavailable as 'git cannot answer (cannot run, time out, unreadable output)', but only the two base probes (rev-parse --verify, merge-base --is-ancestor) feed the count. When the probes answer and the later changed-files query (git diff --name-only -z <base>..HEAD) times out, hits the output limit or returns a non-UTF-8 name, run_git returns None and the cell is dropped silently: no violation, no staleness_unresolvable advisory, no STALENESS_UNRESOLVABLE warning. Reproduced on the built binary: (a) a PATH wrapper that sleeps on 'diff ..HEAD' with CANON_TEST_GIT_DEADLINE_MS=1000: gate check ends in 2.3 s, violations [], advisories hold only spec_coverage_off; (b) one commit changing the declared surface src/a.rs and adding a name with byte 0xff: gate check clean, no advisory, status no warning. These are the silent skips this change set out to count; the bound test covers only 'no git on the PATH', where the probe itself fails. Fix: count the cell as git_unavailable when changed_files_since or commits_behind returns None for a cell that needed it, and add a test for a deadline and a non-UTF-8 name. Blast radius: status shares the count, so it is silent in the same cases; verdicts are unaffected.
